<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Economic Outlook:</strong> Robust Q1 FY27 GDP growth has prompted brokerages to raise fiscal forecasts, though it has simultaneously increased market expectations for a potential RBI rate hike in December.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNYy1uT09sbTYwSGc3cG4ydkxGMWRQdktxengzUUEtMXFWUkY1MUszdVJCOWxGNjFKY0VEZmM2NW8xWGdVWkdfc2tIak45dXZfNUZzOTBJOUUzNnBRcEIyY2hyMWFWaUgyMzJGZU1pY0NsRlYyWE1VMXowQ0txWjNudlJ0X24zWEgzbl9zeWJkakN2Y3J0U05qRjU0ZGhSbmpZSFJxOUgyaGZybmxQdWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I37</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>External Balances:</strong> India’s current account deficit widened to $4.2 billion in Q1, while the rupee reached a two-month peak supported by FPI inflows and RBI intervention.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional Flows:</strong> Markets saw net buying activity on September 1, with FIIs investing ₹1,143 crore and DIIs adding ₹1,847 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Energy and Geopolitics:</strong> Brent crude prices crossing $91 amid US-Iran tensions pressured Indian indices, contributing to a cautious market session where the Nifty closed at 24,055.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global Inflation:</strong> Rising crude oil prices and fiscal risks have triggered a spike in global bond yields, including Japanese yields hitting 3% for the first time in three decades, dampening investor sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
</ul>
